content_of_post_to_answer: Should a person change their personality to impress a date?
answer: Changing small behaviors to be more considerate is part of growing; changing your core personality to secure someone's approval is usually a trap. A date is not just a chance to be chosen, it is a chance to discover whether two people genuinely fit. If you perform a version of yourself that attracts someone, you may end up maintaining a relationship with someone who never met the real you. The right person should appreciate your growth, not require your disguise.
